title: 第25章 自己捅的篓子自己处理第26章 白衣白马剑中仙
content_zh:
喝完茶，陆天明起身走人。
闵昌和那对男女进了包厢。
干坐着也没什么意思。
获取不了更多的情报。
不如回屋休息。
夏婉儿恋恋不舍，起身要送。
陆天明摸出二两银子递给她。
“没事，不用送，应该够买你一晚上了吧？”
夏婉儿点头，眼里有雾气：“够的，公子。”
陆天明颔首，再不停留。
来到一楼，楼梯口撞见老鸨。
陆天明把老鸨拉到一边。
“鸨母，跟你商量个事。”
“你说。”
老鸨眉开眼笑。
像陆天明这样大方的客人，可不多见。
十两银子就喝了一壶茶，前后不过半个时辰。
出道二十多年，还真就没遇到过几个。
陆天明从怀里掏出钱袋递给老鸨。
“夏婉儿赎身的费用。”

老鸨没接，笑着的脸突然僵住。
“她给你说了些什么？”
“没说什么，就是单纯的聊天，你先看看够不够，不够，我再去取。”
老鸨狐疑的打开袋子，接近百两。
夏婉儿一个刚进来没什么名气的小姑娘，哪里值这么多。
但是有钱不要，那是王八蛋。
老鸨立时面露难色：“够是不够的，但既然公子喜欢她，这个主我做了。”
“不喜欢，我只是钱多烧的慌，不过非常感谢你。”
道过谢后，陆天明微笑道：“七天后我会再回来，你家的茶，很好喝。”
老鸨可是人精。
陆天明这话，哪里是茶好喝的意思。
明明就是七天过后，人要是还在这做，你给我走着瞧。
能随手扔百两银子的不是没有。
但无一例外，没一个是好惹的主。
陆天明走后。
老鸨上到二楼。
她将钱袋子放在夏婉儿面前。
content_en:
After drinking tea, Lu Tianming stood up and left.
Min Chang and the man and woman entered the box.
Sitting there is no fun.
No more information can be obtained.
It's better to go back to the house and rest.
Xia Wan'er was reluctant to leave and stood up to see him off.
Lu Tianming took out two taels of silver and handed it to her.
"It's okay, no need to give it away, it should be enough to buy you one night, right?"
Xia Wan'er nodded, her eyes misty: "That's enough, Master."
Lu Tianming nodded and didn't stop any longer.
Arriving on the first floor, I bumped into the madam at the stairs.
Lu Tianming pulled the madam aside.
"Madame, I want to discuss something with you."
"You said."
The madam smiled happily.
It is rare to see such a generous guest as Lu Tianming.
I drank a pot of tea for ten taels of silver, which lasted only half an hour.
In more than 20 years of debut, I really haven’t met many of them.
Lu Tianming took out the money bag from his arms and handed it to the madam.
"The cost of Xia Wan'er's redemption."
The madam didn't answer, and her smiling face suddenly froze.
"What did she tell you?"
"I didn't say anything, just chatting. You check to see if you have enough. If not, I will go get it."
The madam opened the bag suspiciously and found nearly a hundred taels.
How could Xia Wan'er, a little famous girl who just came in, be worth so much?
But if you don’t want it if you have money, that’s a bastard.
The madam immediately looked embarrassed: "Enough is not enough, but since the young master likes her, I will take the initiative."
"I don't like it, I just have too much money to burn, but thank you very much."
After thanking you, Lu Tianming smiled and said, "I will come back in seven days. Your tea is delicious."
The old bustard is a good person.
What Lu Tianming said didn't mean that the tea was delicious.
It's obvious that after seven days, if people are still doing this, just wait and see.
There is no one who can throw away a hundred taels of silver.
But without exception, no one is easy to mess with.
After Lu Tianming left.
The madam went up to the second floor.
She placed the money bag in front of Xia Wan'er.
